liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Bertha** (2 reviews): With Weir's voice gone, the Bertha into Good Lovin' pairing was a novelty but not enough; Phil is all over the place on Bertha [15][19]
- **Here Comes Sunshine** (1 review): Seemed a nice choice as set opener [12]
- **Masterpiece** (1 review): Bobby was very into the show, and Masterpiece was a standout [19]
- **Let it Grow** (1 review): Let It Grow was memorable to the reviewer [12]
- **Attics of My Life** (1 review): Band regains focus after Space with a powerful Attics, following less focused energy post-Space [9]
- **NFA** (1 review): Not Fade Away also provides some sparks late in the show [9]

## Setlist highlights

- **NFA**: back after 259 archived shows (1276 days) [21]

## The recordings

- **gd1993-06-06.sbd.unknown.8246.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 19 songs; 159 min; rated 2.5/5 by 4 [1]
- **gd1993-06-06.sbd.gustin.tetzeli.fix-34835.100023.flac16**: soundboard; 18 songs; 158 min; rated 4.4/5 by 5 [2]. Said about its sound: Jerry's guitar tone is clean, sharp and lively throughout [19]
- **gd93-06-06.sbd.wiley.8329.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 155 min; rated 3.12/5 by 17 [6]. Said about its sound: Soundboard download sounds very good; the whole show can fit on two discs with light editing; Recording sounds better than the show did live in the stadium that night; Good soundboard; Bobby's voice sounds worn out in the second set, audible on Good Lovin' and Playing [9][10][11]
- **gd1993-06-06.fob.sonics.andrewf.105266.flac16**: audience recording; 18 songs; 157 min; rated 3.33/5 by 3 [3]

## Around the show

- The sun slipped below the stadium edge as the band opened with Here Comes Sunshine [17]
- Sting reportedly opened for the Dead, covering Purple Haze, according to the reviewer [18]
- During the space/drums segment, a nearby fan returned a stone the reviewer dropped while dancing [18]
- Second set lacks the first set's energy; the Auburn Hills shows are both better [11]
- Jerry was in better form than at many shows the reviewer saw over the next two years [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1993-06-06.sbd.unknown.8246.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Thanks to Kevin Kaye for the discs.; transferred by Andy Gustin; source: DSBD>CDR>shn [1]
- **gd1993-06-06.sbd.gustin.tetzeli.fix-34835.100023.flac16**: transferred by Andy Gustin and Bill Tetzeli; source: SHNID 8246 (DSBD>CDR>SHN>WAV>FLAC) [2]
- **gd93-06-06.sbd.wiley.8329.sbeok.shnf**: source: DSBD master> Dat Clone> ?> CDR [6]
- **gd1993-06-06.fob.sonics.andrewf.105266.flac16**: transferred by Andrew F.; source: FOB AUD: Sonics Studios mics > Cassette > 1C. [3]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Giants Stadium - June 6, 1993](https://www.dead.net/show/june-6-1993) [22]
- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Giants Stadium - June 6, 1993](https://www.dead.net/show/june-6-1993) [23]
- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1993-06-06 Sun Giants Stadium, East Rutherford, NJ](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1270535035923/grateful-dead-1993-06-06-sun-giants) [24]
- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1993-06-06 Sun Giants Stadium, East Rutherford, NJ](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1270535035923/grateful-dead-1993-06-06-sun-giants) [25]
